# Loadbearer

> A weekly workout board: two training programs (A and B) on a rotation schedule, targets for each exercise by training phase, set-by-set logging, timers, progress charts, weight goals and a muscle map. It's an installable offline web app, and data stays on the device.

## Links

- [Open the app](https://iron-log-947510572244.us-central1.run.app): the live app (moves to loadbearer.app once that domain is live)
- [Source and README](https://github.com/jacgit18/iron-log): features, screenshots and how to run it
